decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already captures the Hero V terminal refinement and preservation of its established structure and slope.
A same-message MODIFY already applies the shared restrained architectural terminal to the É accent while preserving its literal Hero V derivation.
A same-message MODIFY already records the requested comparative terminal interpretations, variation count, review purpose, and geometry-preservation constraint.
The E and L geometry is not changed by this terminal study; the existing same-message MODIFY already refreshes the related rule that expressive flourishes remain excluded from these letters.
A same-message MODIFY already records that only the shared terminal treatment is open for variation while all other established geometry and relationships remain locked.
The source postpones proceeding with material treatments until the terminal study is reviewed but does not change the selected Satin Reflection finish or its required character.
The source explicitly preserves the second V's established structure and slope and does not alter its height relationship to the other letters.
A same-message MODIFY already records the client's selection of Option 2 (Balanced Flow); the terminal refinement adds no further kerning change.
Changing the shared terminal style does not revoke or alter the existing requirement that the É accent and Hero V peaks align on the same horizontal reference.
The selected champagne-gold elements remain the Hero V right arm, second V right arm, and É accent regardless of the refined terminal geometry.
The terminal-study request does not change the standing requirement to explain the design focus or problem addressed by each round.
The terminal refinement does not affect the selected all-caps wordmark treatment.
